basis: Opened firsthand reviews of the November2024 HD-2D remake: PCGamer PC, NintendoLife European Switch, RPGFan PS5. Original publication days are explicit; quotes copied from verdicts. Platform differences are retained, not treated as identical performance tests.

reviews.title: Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake review
reviews.quote: Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D is welcoming for newcomers, a fan's dream, and a truly timeless classic.

reviews.title: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake Review (Switch)
reviews.quote: Though it isn’t without drawbacks, this is easily the most feature-rich and enjoyable version of Dragon Quest III available.

reviews.title: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake
reviews.quote: Square Enix got it right, and I’m excited for the families who get to share this experience for the first time.
